description: App shell, app-specific styles, full app.html structure, SVG avatar builder module, and main app controller. Depends on FEAT-001 (main.css must exist). FEAT-003 and FEAT-004 depend on this FEAT's app.html and avatar-builder.js being in place.
steps: Create d:\Anti-LinkedIn\styles\app.css. Mobile-first styles for the entire app shell and all tab panels. App shell: .app-body { margin:0; overflow:hidden; height:100dvh; background:var(--color-gray-100) }. .app-shell { display:flex; flex-direction:column; height:100dvh; max-width:600px; margin:0 auto; background:white; position:relative }. .app-header { height:56px; background:white; border-bottom:1px solid var(--color-gray-100); display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; padding:0 16px; flex-shrink:0; position:sticky; top:0; z-index:10 }. .app-header .logo { font-family:var(--font-display); font-weight:900; font-size:1.2rem; color:var(--color-navy) }. .user-level-area { display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:flex-end; gap:4px }. #user-level-badge { font-size:0.7rem; font-weight:700; color:var(--color-orange); background:rgba(255,107,53,0.1); padding:2px 10px; border-radius:var(--radius-pill) }. .xp-bar { width:80px; height:5px; background:var(--color-gray-100); border-radius:var(--radius-pill); overflow:hidden }. .xp-fill { height:100%; background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--color-yellow),var(--color-orange)); border-radius:var(--radius-pill); transition:width 0.6s ease; width:0% }. .tab-content { flex:1; overflow-y:auto; padding:16px; padding-bottom:80px; -webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch }. .tab-panel { display:none }. .tab-panel.active { display:block }. .bottom-nav { position:fixed; bottom:0; left:50%; transform:translateX(-50%); width:100%; max-width:600px; height:64px; background:white; border-top:1px solid var(--color-gray-100); display:flex; align-items:stretch; z-index:20 }. .nav-item { flex:1; display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:2px; cursor:pointer; border:none; background:transparent; color:var(--color-gray-400); font-size:0.6rem; font-weight:600; padding:8px 4px; transition:color 0.2s; letter-spacing:0.01em }. .nav-item:hover,.nav-item.active { color:var(--color-yellow) }. .nav-item .nav-icon { font-size:1.3rem; line-height:1 }. .nav-item.active .nav-icon { transform:scale(1.1) }. XP bar: (see above). Avatar builder: .avatar-builder-layout { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:20px }. @media(min-width:768px){ .avatar-builder-layout { flex-direction:row; gap:32px } .avatar-panel-left { flex:0 0 300px } .avatar-panel-right { flex:1 } }. .avatar-canvas-wrapper { width:100%; max-width:300px; aspect-ratio:1; background:#F8F8F8; border-radius:var(--radius-lg); margin:0 auto; overflow:hidden; border:2px solid var(--color-gray-100) }. #avatar-svg { width:100%; height:100%; display:block }. .panel-section-title { font-weight:800; font-size:0.85rem; color:var(--color-gray-400); text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0.1em; margin:16px 0 8px }. .character-grid { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:10px }. .character-card { border:2px solid var(--color-gray-100); border-radius:var(--radius-md); padding:12px 8px; cursor:pointer; text-align:center; transition:all 0.2s }. .character-card:hover { border-color:var(--color-yellow); background:rgba(245,197,24,0.05) }. .character-card.selected { border-color:var(--color-yellow); background:rgba(245,197,24,0.1) }. .character-card .char-name { font-size:0.72rem; font-weight:700; color:var(--color-navy); margin-top:4px; line-height:1.3 }. .accessory-list { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:8px }. .accessory-row { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; padding:12px; border:1px solid var(--color-gray-100); border-radius:var(--radius-md); cursor:pointer; transition:all 0.2s }. .accessory-row:hover { border-color:var(--color-yellow) }. .accessory-row.equipped { background:rgba(245,197,24,0.12); border-color:var(--color-yellow) }. .accessory-row .acc-info { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; font-size:0.85rem; font-weight:600 }. .accessory-row .acc-status { font-size:0.72rem; padding:2px 8px; border-radius:var(--radius-pill); font-weight:700 }. .acc-status.free { background:rgba(34,197,94,0.15); color:var(--color-success) }. .acc-status.premium { background:rgba(255,107,53,0.15); color:var(--color-orange) }. Feed: .feed-section-header { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; margin-bottom:16px }. .post-card { background:white; border:1px solid var(--color-gray-100); border-radius:var(--radius-lg); padding:16px; margin-bottom:12px; box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.04) }. .post-header { display:flex; align-items:flex-start; gap:12px; margin-bottom:10px }. .post-avatar-wrap { width:48px; height:48px; border-radius:50%; overflow:hidden; flex-shrink:0; background:var(--color-gray-100) }. .post-avatar-wrap svg { width:100%; height:100% }. .post-meta { flex:1 }. .post-username { font-weight:700; font-size:0.9rem; color:var(--color-navy) }. .post-badges { display:flex; gap:6px; flex-wrap:wrap; margin-top:3px }. .level-badge { font-size:0.65rem; padding:1px 8px; border-radius:var(--radius-pill); font-weight:700; color:white }. .cat-badge { font-size:0.65rem; padding:1px 8px; border-radius:var(--radius-pill); font-weight:700 }. .post-timestamp { font-size:0.72rem; color:var(--color-gray-400) }. .post-text { font-size:0.92rem; line-height:1.6; color:#374151; margin-bottom:12px }. .reaction-row { display:flex; gap:8px; flex-wrap:wrap }. .reaction-btn { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:5px; padding:6px 12px; border:1.5px solid var(--color-gray-100); border-radius:var(--radius-pill); background:white; cursor:pointer; font-size:0.8rem; font-weight:600; color:var(--color-navy); transition:all 0.2s }. .reaction-btn:hover { border-color:var(--color-yellow); background:rgba(245,197,24,0.08) }. .reaction-btn.reacted { background:var(--color-navy); color:white; border-color:var(--color-navy) }. .cert-btn { margin-left:auto; padding:6px 14px; border:1.5px solid var(--color-gray-100); border-radius:var(--radius-pill); background:white; cursor:pointer; font-size:0.78rem; font-weight:600; color:var(--color-gray-400); transition:all 0.2s }. .cert-btn:hover { border-color:var(--color-orange); color:var(--color-orange) }. Create tab: #tab-create .create-form { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:14px }. .form-label { font-weight:700; font-size:0.85rem; color:var(--color-navy); margin-bottom:4px }. .form-select,.form-textarea { width:100%; padding:12px 14px; border:2px solid var(--color-gray-100); border-radius:var(--radius-md); font-size:0.95rem; font-family:var(--font-body); outline:none; transition:border-color 0.2s }. .form-select:focus,.form-textarea:focus { border-color:var(--color-yellow) }. .form-textarea { resize:vertical; min-height:120px }. .char-count { font-size:0.78rem; color:var(--color-gray-400); text-align:right }. .ai-warning { background:rgba(239,68,68,0.08); border:1px solid var(--color-danger); border-radius:var(--radius-md); padding:12px 14px; color:var(--color-danger); font-size:0.85rem; font-weight:600 }. Shop: .shop-grid { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:14px }. @media(min-width:768px){ .shop-grid { grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr) } }. .shop-item-card { border:2px solid var(--color-gray-100); border-radius:var(--radius-lg); padding:20px 14px; text-align:center; transition:all 0.2s }. .shop-item-card:hover { border-color:var(--color-yellow); transform:translateY(-2px) }. .shop-item-emoji { font-size:2.8rem; display:block; margin-bottom:10px }. .shop-item-name { font-weight:800; font-size:0.9rem; color:var(--color-navy); margin-bottom:4px }. .shop-item-desc { font-size:0.78rem; color:var(--color-gray-400); margin-bottom:10px; line-height:1.4 }. .shop-item-price { font-weight:900; font-size:1rem; color:var(--color-orange); margin-bottom:12px }. Profile: .profile-section { text-align:center; padding:20px 0 }. .profile-avatar-wrap { width:120px; height:120px; border-radius:50%; overflow:hidden; margin:0 auto 16px; background:var(--color-gray-100); border:3px solid var(--color-yellow) }. .profile-avatar-wrap svg { width:100%; height:100% }. .profile-username { font-family:var(--font-display); font-weight:900; font-size:1.4rem; color:var(--color-navy); margin-bottom:4px }. .profile-level { font-size:0.85rem; color:var(--color-orange); font-weight:700; margin-bottom:16px }. .profile-xp-area { max-width:240px; margin:0 auto 20px }. .profile-xp-label { font-size:0.78rem; color:var(--color-gray-400); margin-bottom:4px }. .xp-bar-lg { height:10px; background:var(--color-gray-100); border-radius:var(--radius-pill); overflow:hidden }. .xp-fill-lg { height:100%; background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--color-yellow),var(--color-orange)); border-radius:var(--radius-pill); transition:width 0.6s }. .profile-stats { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:12px; max-width:320px; margin:0 auto 24px }. .stat-card { background:var(--color-gray-100); border-radius:var(--radius-md); padding:16px; text-align:center }. .stat-num { font-family:var(--font-display); font-weight:900; font-size:1.6rem; color:var(--color-navy) }. .stat-label { font-size:0.72rem; color:var(--color-gray-400); font-weight:600 }. .badges-section-title { font-weight:800; font-size:0.85rem; color:var(--color-gray-400); text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0.1em; margin-bottom:12px }. .badges-row { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:8px; justify-content:center }. Certificate modal: .cert-modal-card { background:var(--color-yellow); border:3px double var(--color-navy); border-radius:var(--radius-lg); padding:28px 24px; text-align:center; position:relative; font-family:var(--font-display) }. .cert-modal-logo { font-size:2rem; margin-bottom:8px }. .cert-modal-title { font-size:0.7rem; letter-spacing:0.2em; text-transform:uppercase; font-weight:700; color:var(--color-navy); margin-bottom:4px }. .cert-modal-org { font-size:1.3rem; font-weight:900; color:var(--color-navy); margin-bottom:16px }. .cert-modal-body { font-size:0.85rem; color:var(--color-navy); line-height:1.7; margin-bottom:16px }. .cert-modal-username { font-weight:900; font-size:1rem; display:block }. .cert-modal-category { font-weight:700; text-decoration:underline }. .cert-modal-date { font-size:0.72rem; color:rgba(26,39,68,0.6); margin-bottom:12px }. .cert-modal-stempel { display:inline-block; border:2px solid var(--color-danger); color:var(--color-danger); padding:4px 12px; font-size:0.65rem; font-weight:900; letter-spacing:0.1em; transform:rotate(-8deg); background:rgba(255,255,255,0.7) }. .cert-modal-watermark { position:absolute; top:50%; left:50%; transform:translate(-50%,-50%) rotate(-30deg); font-size:1.6rem; color:rgba(26,39,68,0.06); font-weight:900; pointer-events:none; white-space:nowrap }. .cert-modal-actions { display:flex; gap:10px; margin-top:20px; justify-content:center; flex-wrap:wrap }. QRIS modal: .qris-modal-body { text-align:center }. .qris-item-info { margin-bottom:16px }. .qris-code-box { width:180px; height:180px; background:white; border-radius:var(--radius-md); margin:0 auto 20px; border:2px solid var(--color-gray-100); display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; overflow:hidden }. .qris-actions { display:flex; gap:10px; justify-content:center }. Toast: .toast { position:fixed; bottom:76px; left:50%; transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(10px); background:var(--color-navy); color:white; padding:12px 24px; border-radius:var(--radius-pill); font-weight:600; font-size:0.9rem; z-index:300; opacity:0; transition:all 0.3s; pointer-events:none; white-space:nowrap }. .toast.show { opacity:1; transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(0) }.

Function _getSVG(characterId, equippedAccessories): returns full <svg viewBox='0 0 300 300' xmlns=...> string with _characters[characterId](equippedAccessories) content plus accessory g elements for each id in equippedAccessories. Function _render(): get state, set document.getElementById('avatar-svg').innerHTML = character+accessories content (don't replace outer svg, just fill innerHTML). Function _saveState(): localStorage.setItem('sambatin_avatar', JSON.stringify(_state)). Function _loadState(): parse sambatin_avatar or use default.
